prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1057; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you were involved in at an intersection in League City, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently receive mail.

A: I'd rather just give the name on the policy. I live in League City, on the same street as always.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me, in your own words, what happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light, waiting to turn left. The car behind me didn't slow down in time and hit my rear bumper pretty hard. My head snapped back and then forward.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any pain right after the impact?

A: Not right away. About an hour later my right shoulder started aching, and by evening I couldn't lift my arm above my shoulder without sharp pain.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the next morning. They took X-rays and told me I had a strained muscle and inflammation in the shoulder. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Did you have any shoulder problems before this collision?

A: I had some minor stiffness a few years back, but nothing that kept me from working or sleeping. It had fully resolved before this happened.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble with overhead tasks at work, and I'd like to be kept informed about the claim.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
